🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, per the supplied regime label; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength. The breadth and positive copper/gold ratio (1W: +2.33% | 1M: +5.41%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND) are supportive, but VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND) and stocks versus bonds (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) do not confirm a clean risk-on signal.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear is increasing: VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND). Credit is mixed: HYG/LQD (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.68%, ↑ rising over 1W, RECOVERY) signals slight weekly easing but deterioration over the month; SPY/TLT (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) shows bonds outperforming stocks.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Mixed: dollar strength (1W: -0.03% | 1M: +0.38%, → flat, CORRECTION) is essentially unchanged weekly, while the yield curve (1W: -0.07% | 1M: +4.79%, → flat, CORRECTION) has pulled back after a monthly rise. Duration preference (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +2.51%, → flat, CORRECTION) also shows a short-term pullback.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Broad sector breadth is positive, but technology is the clear laggard: XLK (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.25%, BELOW TREND). The XLK/XLF relative-strength ratio (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -14.96%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) favors Financials over Tech; style: Value/Cyclicals over Growth, with the 10/11 breadth supporting the rotation.

5. US vs Global?
Regional leadership is mixed: VGK relative to SPY (1W: +2.44% | 1M: +3.21%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND) and India relative to EM (1W: +3.73% | 1M: +13.72%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND) are strong, while EEM (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -8.64%, BELOW TREND) lags. FXI is in RECOVERY (1W: +2.38% | 1M: -2.48%); Europe’s relative strength does not translate into broad EM strength.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation remains weak: ARKK (1W: -1.51% | 1M: -8.84%, BELOW TREND) and IBIT (1W: -5.66% | 1M: -9.59%, BELOW TREND) are both under pressure. Small caps are firmer: IWM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +0.11%, ABOVE TREND).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Energy strength contrasts with precious-metals weakness: BNO (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +13.41%, ABOVE TREND) and GLD (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -7.05%, BELOW TREND). Copper is soft despite the positive copper/gold ratio: CPER (1W: -0.18% | 1M: -1.32%, BELOW TREND).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy remains strong: XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%, ABOVE TREND), with Brent exposure via BNO (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +13.41%, ABOVE TREND). Natural gas remains weak: UNG (1W: -5.22% | 1M: -10.63%, BELOW TREND).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed strength: XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%, ABOVE TREND) and IWM (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +0.11%, ABOVE TREND) are positive across both periods. Weakness is also consistent in XLK (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.25%, BELOW TREND); VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%, ABOVE TREND) rising against the broad sector breadth makes the risk-on signal less convincing.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor value and cyclical exposure selectively, while reducing exposure to technology and speculative themes. Broad breadth is supportive, but rising VXX (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%, ABOVE TREND) and falling SPY/TLT (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%, BELOW TREND) argue against an indiscriminate risk-on stance.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: If broad breadth holds, monitor XLE (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +11.67%, ABOVE TREND) for continued leadership.
BEARISH: If technology weakness persists, reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.25%, BELOW TREND).

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: If energy momentum holds, monitor BNO (1W: +0.56% | 1M: +13.41%, ABOVE TREND).
BEARISH: If precious-metals weakness extends, monitor GLD (1W: -2.95% | 1M: -7.05%, BELOW TREND) and SLV (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -18.94%, BELOW TREND).

13. Key Levels?
Monitor VXX at 19.21 (1W: +2.62% | 1M: +7.98%, ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND), HYG/LQD at 0.7426 (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -1.68%, ↑ rising weekly, RECOVERY), and SPY/TLT at 9.2341 (1W: -1.45% | 1M: -7.04%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND). The XLK/XLF ratio at 3.1766 (1W: -4.49% | 1M: -14.96%, ↓ falling, BELOW TREND) is a key style-rotation gauge.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON is the supplied regime; Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength. Energy and Financials-relative-to-Tech are showing strength, consistent with a Value/Cyclicals tilt. Rising VXX and falling SPY/TLT are the key divergences to monitor against the broad breadth signal.
